incidental_findings.finding: 'Show 2 + 1 on the number line' asks for a demonstration but the key is the single value 3, and no number line appears. The definite article points at an object the pupil cannot see.
'One group has 1 item and another group has 1 item' leaves 'item' unnamed - the reason the 'concrete' clause fails.
